'''2007 Georgia State Championship Andrew Kaplan LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Andrew Kaplan]] at [[2007 Georgia State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Fluffy Clouds
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
